description:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a senior client-platform engineer to own and evolve the ELERA point-of-sale client – the Vue 3 and TypeScript application framework behind our fixed-lane, self-checkout, kiosk, specialty, associate-mobile, and customer-display experiences. This is a successor role on a defined architect track: the person hired will be trained to become the architect for the ELERA POS client.   

 This is a platform role, not a feature role. Most of the work is not screens. It is the framework other teams build their screens out of: a dependency-injection and plugin system that retailers and partners extend through, a configuration merge chain that resolves customer overrides, a device layer that talks to lane hardware, a legacy Dojo application that must keep shipping beside the modern client, and the build train that releases all of it together.   

 The role requires experience building solutions on Vue.js and Java enterprise technologies with a focus on complex browser-side functionality. The ideal candidate will excel in our fast-paced, collaborative, customer-first environment, and is looking for a path into architecture rather than a larger backlog.   

 Responsibilities:   

 
 Design, develop, and test/debug client UI and client framework code in Vue 3 and TypeScript, and mentor the team doing the same   

 
 
 Design with other developers in mind – both the internal team and the retailer, partner, and services engineers who extend the platform from outside   

 
 
 Own and extend the client extensibility model: dependency injection and decorator-based registration, plugin loading, UI slot injection, and the base/TGCS/partner/customer configuration merge chain   

 
 
 Maintain backward compatibility for plugins and customizations built against earlier framework versions   

 
 
 Publish versioned shared packages consumed by other teams, with real semantic-versioning and deprecation discipline   

 
 
 Keep two UI generations shippable at once, migrating the legacy Dojo layer incrementally rather than by flag day   

 
 
 Extend the device integration layer – scanners, scales, printers, payment terminals, cash recyclers, customer display – including the mock device harness that lets the full client run on a laptop   

 
 
 Maintain the client release train: hybrid Maven/npm builds, monorepo publishing, Jenkins multi-branch pipelines across the framework dependency chain, and constrained or air-gapped customer environments   

 
 
 Own client-side quality: unit and component tests under a coverage gate, and a browser-automated BDD suite that gates the build   

 
 
 Write and defend architecture decision records, component analyses, and solution designs; represent the client stack at the Architecture Review Board   

 
 
 Maintain the client Self-Enablement Guide and generated extension catalogs, and serve as a technical interface to key technology partners   

 
 
 Perform unit and functional tests of product features, and resolve unit, functional, and customer- or partner-reported defects across supported release lines   

 
 
 Provide reasonable estimates, meet deliverables while assisting the team, and enable the team to meet their KPIs   

 
 
 Use good programming patterns, call out anti-patterns, and handle accelerating change in pursuit of more innovative solutions   

 
 Required Skills:   

 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience   

 
 
 Software Engineer III: 5+ years of professional web development experience. Software Engineer IV: 9+ years of full-stack web development experience, particularly client side   

 
 
 Strong analytical and TypeScript/OO programming skills, including generics, declaration files, and strict-mode discipline   

 
 
 2+ years in Vue 3 or an equivalent modern component framework, at depth: reactivity semantics, routing, and centralized state management   

 
 
 Experience building shared libraries or frameworks that other teams consume – not only end-user features   

 
 
 Working knowledge of a dependency-injection / inversion-of-control container (InversifyJS, tsyringe, Angular DI, Spring, or similar) and decorator-based registration; understanding of lifetimes and resolution order   

 
 
 Deep technical skills in web development technologies (HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SASS, XML/JSON, Vue.js), including module-system fluency (ESM, AMD, UMD) and modern build tooling such as Vite   

 
 
 Unit testing as a default habit, plus browser automation with at least one of Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium – including the ability to diagnose a flaky test rather than retry it   

 
 
 Demonstrated ability to work productively inside a large legacy code base without rewriting it   

 
 
 Experience developing in a Java-based environment, including enterprise/web-based content, sufficient to debug a service you do not own and determine where a defect actually lives   

 
 
 REST and OpenAPI contract thinking, including a working definition of a breaking change   

 
 
 Comfort in CI/CD: pipelines, containerized builds, artifact registries, dependency resolution, lockfiles, and transitive version conflicts   

 
 
 Proficiency with Git at team scale: long-lived release lines, backports, and conflict resolution that does not lose work   

 
 
 Experience with operating systems – Linux, Windows, iOS or Android; installation, light administration, and simple scripting   

 
 
 Knowledge of software development concepts, methodology, and life cycle, especially Agile   

 
 
 Clear technical writing, and a record of documenting decisions that others then followed. Communication is a hiring criterion for this role, not a bonus   

 
 
 Strong problem determination and debugging skills, attention to detail, and teamwork   

 
 Preferred Skills:   

 
 Point-of-sale, kiosk, self-checkout, or other attended/unattended retail systems, and general knowledge of the retail industry domain   

 
 
 Plugin or extension architectures that third parties build against, and experience designing extension points that outlive their first consumer   

 
 
 Skills and experience with POS attached devices (scanners, scales, printers, payment terminals, cash recyclers) and duplex device protocols such as WebSocket or STOMP, including retry, reconnect, and half-open connection handling   

 
 
 Experience debugging a failure that turned out to be in hardware, firmware, or a driver rather than in application code   

 
 
 Cross-document and cross-context work: iframes, post Message, origin and window-context reasoning, storage scoping   

 
 
 Working knowledge of Dojo, React, or AngularJS in addition to Vue.js, or comparable experience maintaining a superseded framework in production   

 
 
 Working knowledge of Docker containers and Spring Boot; knowledge of Swagger and REST design   

 
  

 Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self-checkout at Lowe's Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ's, or Costco? These are just a few examples of our in-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader.

The nature of retail is changing quickly, so if you share our 'Together Commerce' vision of a seamless two-way, participatory shopping experience, let's get together to drive the new economy.

 Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions, Inc. offers a competitive salary and generous benefits package including the following: 



 
 Group health coverage (medical, dental, & vision)

 Employee Assistance Programs

 Pre-tax spending accounts

 401(k) plan (with company match)

 Company provided life insurance

 Pet Insurance

 Employee discounts

 Generous paid holiday schedule, paid vacation & sick/personal days

 
 

 EEO: 

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer that evaluates qualified applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, religious creed, disability, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression and sexual orientation or any other protected factor. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process should email benefits@toshibagcs.com to request an accommodation

 DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION: 

We at Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions firmly believe that our people are an integral part to the success of our customers. Furthermore, we're committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion for all our people as highlighted by our 5 Core Principles (Create Outreach, Foster Belonging, Unleash Opportunity, Diverse Cultural Engagement and Culture of Transparency). We're passionate about our customers the retail industry and becoming a more responsible company as we help create a brighter future.
